                             ADMISSION CRITERIA AND GUIDELINES
           Four-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP – BA B. Ed Secondary)
                                         Academic Year 2026–27
                        Rangapara College (Autonomous), UGC & NCTE Recognized
 All candidates seeking admission to the Four-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP –
 B.A.-B.Ed. Secondary) at Rangapara College (Autonomous) for the Academic Session 2026–2027 are
 hereby informed that the admission criteria, eligibility conditions, and other relevant guidelines are as
 detailed below.

Candidates interested in seeking admission to the programme must register and submit their online application
through the Assam SAMARTH ITEP Admission Portal at https://assamadmitep.samarth.ac.in/index.php
within the stipulated period. The admission schedule, as notified by the Higher Education Department,
Government of Assam, is enclosed herewith for the information and guidance of all applicants.


            1. Mode of Admission: 1. Mode of Admission: Admission to the Four-Year Integrated Teacher
   Education Programme (ITEP – B.A.-B.Ed. Secondary) shall be made strictly on the basis of NTA-NCET 2026
   score. Eligible candidates are required to register and submit their online application through the Assam
   SAMARTH Admission Portal at https://assamadmitep.samarth.ac.in/index.php within the stipulated timeline
   notified by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Assam.

        2. Eligibility Criteria
   To be eligible for admission, candidates must:
   i) Have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) or equivalent examination from a recognized board.
   ii) Have qualified in the NTA-NCET 2026 examination.
   iii) Have secured a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in 10+2 (General category). Relaxation in
   minimum marks applies as follows:

      •   SC/ST: 5% relaxation (i.e., minimum 45%)
      •   M/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3% relaxation (i.e., minimum 47%)

      3. Merit List Preparation Criteria

      •   A category-wise merit list will be prepared based on the NTA-NCET 2026 scores and the
          preferences indicated by candidates during the submission of their online application on the
          SAMARTH Portal.
      •   Candidates who have selected Rangapara College (Autonomous) as their first preference will
          be given priority in the shortlisting process.
    •   For instance, a candidate with an 80 Score who has given Rangapara College (Autonomous) as
       their first preference will be considered for shortlisting before a candidate with a 90 score who
       has listed the college as their second preference or lower preference.
   •   Candidates who have given second or lower preference to Rangapara College will be considered
       only after all first-preference candidates have been accommodated.
   •   If all seats are filled by first-preference candidates, those with second or lower preferences shall
       not be considered, regardless of their scores. No claims will be entertained from candidates
       who have not listed Rangapara College (Autonomous) as their first preference.
   •   If a candidate declines the admission offer, they will not be considered in subsequent merit lists

       In case of a tie in NCET scores, the following tie-breakers will be applied in order:
       a) Higher percentile in the Teaching Aptitude section.
       b) Older age (based on date of birth).

4. Reservation Policy

     Reservation of seats for various categories of candidates shall be made in
   accordance with the prevailing Reservation Policy of the Government of Assam
   applicable to State Government-funded Higher Education Institutions.

                                       TOTAL SEAT- 50
                                    For STATE (ASSAM QUOTA)
TOTAL SEATS          UR       EWS      M/OBC (NCL)    ST-P  ST-H                   SC          EC/FV
       50            20        5            13         5      1                     3            3

Out of the total 50 seats available in the programme, 10 seats shall be earmarked for candidates
belonging to states other than Assam. If sufficient eligible candidates are not available in either the
Assam or the other States category, the vacant seats may be filled from the other category during the Spot
Admission Round, subject to the prevailing admission guidelines and availability of eligible candidates.

Note: Candidates applying under any reserved category must present original and valid supporting
documents at the time of admission. Acceptable documents include the Caste Certificate, Non-Creamy
Layer (NCL) Certificate, EWS Certificate, Extra-Curricular Certificate, or Fringe Village
Certificate, all of which must be issued by a competent authority. Acknowledgement receipts will not
be accepted under any circumstances.
       In the event that no eligible candidates are available under a particular reserved category, the
vacant seats will be converted to the Open Category and filled based on merit during Spot
Admission.
 5. Course of Study: BA-B.Ed (Secondary) – Under ITEP
         The BA-B. Ed (Secondary) is a Four-Year Integrated Dual Degree Programme offered under
the Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP), in alignment with the vision of the National
Education Policy (NEP) 2020. This programme is designed to prepare competent and reflective
secondary school teachers by integrating subject-specific content knowledge with professional teacher
training.
         This comprehensive course structure ensures that students graduate with both a Bachelor of Arts
(BA) and a Bachelor of Education (B. Ed) degree, equipping them with the academic foundation and
pedagogical skills necessary for a successful teaching career at the secondary level.
         At Rangapara College (Autonomous), the following subject combinations are available under
the BA-B.Ed (ITEP) programme:

Restrictions:
   • Major-2 Subject Allotment: Each subject will have a maximum of 15 seats available for
       Major-2 specialization. Allotment of Major subjects will be done strictly on the basis of merit.
       Securing admission to the programme does not guarantee a Major-2 in a preferred subject,
       as it will depend on the candidate’s merit rank and seat availability.
   • A language subject cannot be selected as a minor if another language subject is chosen as the
       major. For example, Hindi cannot be opted as a minor when English is selected as the major
       subject, and vice versa.
    •   History and Political Science cannot be taken together as a major and minor combination in
       either order. For example, if Political Science is chosen as the major, History cannot be selected
       as the minor, and vice versa.
   •   Ability Enhancement Course (AEC): In accordance with NCTE guidelines, applicants may
       choose any one of the following Scheduled Indian Languages as their Ability Enhancement
       Course (AEC): Assamese, Bengali, Bodo, or Hindi

       6. Admission Process: The entire admission process will be conducted online through the
SAMARTH Portal: https://assamadmitep.samarth.ac.in/index.php Candidates must register and
submit their applications within the specified timeline as notified by the Director of Higher
Education, Assam. Offline or manual applications will not be accepted under any circumstances.

        7. Compliance: All admission procedures will be carried out in strict adherence to the guidelines
issued by the NCTE, NTA, UGC, and the Government of Assam.

     8. Admission Fee: (for 2026-27 Batch)
  Semester     I         II        III     IV                   V             VII           VII          VIII
    Fee    26500/- 24000/- 26000/- 24000/-                    26000/-       24000/-       26000/-       24000/-

   •   The fee includes charges for University Registration and Sports Board fee.
   •   End Semester Examination fees, Centre fee must be paid separately at the time of filling out the Examination
       Form.
   •   Fees for Internship, Field Work, Practical Components, Educational Visits, and other academic activities, if
       applicable, shall be charged separately.
   •   Semester fees must be paid within fifteen days from the commencement of each semester
   •   Hostel Admission Fee: Rs. 9,000/- (per year Hostel Renewal Admission Fee: Rs. 8,000/)- (excluding mess
       charges) wef 2026-27 Batch)

       9.     Final Notes
   •   Admission will be provisional, subject to the verification of original documents.
   •   Submission of any false or misleading information will lead to immediate cancellation of
       admission.
   •   The college reserves the right to revise or modify the admission policy in response to any updates
       or directives issued by the Govt. of Assam or regulatory bodies.
